how to generate radiology invoice

To generate a radiology invoice, follow these steps:

1. **Choose Service for Billing**: Select the appropriate consultation or service from the service list.
2. **Select Item Code**: For billing services like radiology, select the item code or name from the list.
3. **Add Items**: Click on the “Add” button to include the selected radiology items. These added items will be displayed on a grid below.
4. **Select Payment Category**: Choose the payment category and allocate the cash/credit scheme to the patient. Use F7 for credit facility and F9 for cash facility.
5. **Utilization of Privilege Cards**: If applicable, click on ‘Prv Card’ to display all available privilege cards associated with the patient along with their utilization details. Double click on the card for utilization.
6. **Generate Invoice**: Click the ‘Save’ button to generate the service bill.
7. **Reprint Bill**: If needed, click the ‘Reprint’ button to generate a reprint of the bill.
8. **Payment Options**: Payments can be made via card (credit or debit) or cash.
9. **Thank You Message**: A checkbox is available near ‘Consult SMS’ for sending a thankful message to the patient for the consultation.

For further assistance, you may refer to the image provided in the document: ![Related Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_113730.png).

cscan

The CScan form is used to scan the cards submitted by patients, such as insurance cards. You can access this screen by clicking the ‘CScan’ button from the OP service billing screen. Mandatory fields are marked in red, and you need to enter a file number, which can be done manually or selected using a nearby button. Additionally, all patient-attached documents can be viewed by clicking the ‘VScan’ button, where they can also be printed, downloaded, or converted to PDF format. For more details, you can refer to the images provided: ![CScan Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_114335.png) and ![VScan Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_114308.png).
